# Allowlist used with real-probe.json (collect_test.go TestRealProbe). Each probe test that is
# meant to be allowed gets its skip allowed only when the reason was read correctly.
example\.com/probe/a	Test.*	allowed reason	the reason the probe gives every skip it allows
example\.com/probe/a	TestHeaderLikeContinuation	allowed reason\n    gen\.go:12: generated by stringer	matches only when the indented second line stays part of the message
example\.com/probe/a	TestLongSkip	long a{1000}a{1000}a{1000}	matches only when the 1024-byte events of the line are joined
example\.com/probe/a	TestHugeSkip	huge b+	the message is cut at 4 KiB, and the cut text still matches
example\.com/probe/a	TestManyLineSkip	line 1(\nline [0-9]+)*	the message is cut at 20 lines
example\.com/probe/a	TestSkipNow|TestStdoutNoNewlineSkipNow		SkipNow without a message: an empty reason
example\.com/probe/a	TestLogThenSkipNow	logged before SkipNow	SkipNow after a log: the log is the reason
